impact: Small, two-month-old trades in two holdings (GOOGL, MSFT); a sentiment note only, not a size that moves either stock.
summary: President Trump's OGE 278-T periodic transaction report, filed November 19 and collected by Unusual Whales, shows a sale of Alphabet Class A (GOOGL) and purchases of Microsoft, Nvidia and AMD, each worth $1,001 to $15,000, all traded September 9, 2026.
title: Trump filing: sold GOOGL, bought MSFT, NVDA, AMD ($1K-$15K each), filed Nov 19
